text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is already over, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! I mean, after all, there's even 
more fun waiting for us after this, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho... It seems all eyes are on 
me. Is that because of my position, I 
wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's just what I was waiting to 
hear♪ I really hope that comes true~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, without any exaggeration, she has 
grown even stronger over the summer... and 
she still shows plenty of room for 
improvement.
choice_data_list: Let's surprise everyone at the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a surprise, huh! Yeah, I'll give them 
an extra-special thrillâª

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're noisy as hell for folks whose camp 
just ended.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Look around you, everyone else is wiped 
out. Were you the only one slacking off?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then that nonchalant 
Shakur was just goofing off too, but... I 
know that wasn't the case, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Both you and I worked our hardest... and 
grew that much stronger for it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...How much you grow ain't determined by 
something as simple as 'hard work'.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You think so? I believe in hard work.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This precious repetition is bound to lead 
to a wonderful outcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah. How remarkably noble of you, Your 
Royal Highness.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You don't scream, and you don't lose your 
cool. ...You just charge up those slopes 
like they're nothing."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I saw it coming. That you'd achieve 
results beyond what any of you initially 
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...? Thank you? That's rare of you, giving 
me an honest compliment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's the Shuka Sho or the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup. You will produce 
results. There is no doubt."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Your climax is... right there, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Don't ya go forgettin' it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Then don't you dare look away from Shakur 
either~!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what that was all about, 
Shakur...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Well, since you're complimenting me, I 
guess I'll take it and be happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging from Air Shakur's past behavior, 
it's hard to believe she's merely 
complimenting her... but Fine Motion seems 
ready to accept it as is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, and so, the eventful summer 
training camp came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...High tide. In other words, the tide 
will inevitably recede after this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And you don't even struggle. How cruel.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... it would've been better for 
you if you never had any 'talent for 
running' to begin with."
